description: This chart illustrates the percentage distribution of responses categorized as “Ours,” “Standard,” “Generated Response,” and “Other.” The horizontal axis displays the categories: “Ours,” “Standard,” and “Generated Response,” with an additional “Other” category, and is not ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents percentage, labeled as such, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100% and tick labels at 20% intervals. Three stacked bars are present, each representing a category on the horizontal axis. The “Ours” bar is composed of blue (60.6%) and orange (25.3%) segments, while the “Standard” bar is composed of blue (23.6%) and orange (51.1%) segments. The “Generated Response” bar is composed of blue (31.7%) and green (approximately 1.3%) segments. The percentages are displayed directly on each segment of the stacked bars. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
